mapper.select: SELECT receipt_id AS receiptId, event_json AS eventJson, state_name AS stateName FROM mk_quarantine WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quarantine_id = #{quarantineId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT quarantine_id AS quarantineId, receipt_id AS receiptId, reason_code AS reasonCode, state_name AS stateName, created_at AS createdAt, replayed_at AS replayedAt FROM mk_quarantine WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT source_uri AS sourceUri, allowed_types AS allowedTypes, schema_versions AS schemaVersions, max_lateness_seconds AS maxLatenessSeconds, enabled_value AS enabledValue FROM mk_source_registration WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_id = #{sourceId}

SELECT candidate.tenant_id AS tenantId, candidate.outbox_id AS outboxId, candidate.destination_topic AS destinationTopic, candidate.partition_key AS partitionKey, candidate.payload_json AS payloadJson, candidate.publish_attempts AS publishAttempts, candidate.lease_version AS leaseVersion, candidate.depth_bucket_id AS depthBucketId FROM mk_event_outbox candidate WHERE candidate.published_at IS NULL AND candidate.dead_lettered_at IS NULL AND ( (candidate.publish_state = 'PENDING' AND candidate.next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (candidate.publish_state = 'SENDING' AND candidate.lease_until <= #{now}) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mk_event_outbox predecessor WHERE predecessor.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND predecessor.destination_topic = candidate.destination_topic AND predecessor.partition_key = candidate.partition_key AND predecessor.published_at IS NULL AND predecessor.dead_lettered_at IS NULL AND predecessor.stream_sequence < candidate.stream_sequence ) ORDER BY candidate.created_at, candidate.stream_sequence LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_event_outbox SET publish_state = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, publish_attempts = #{publishAttempts}, last_error = '', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND outbox_id = #{outboxId} AND publish_state = 'SENDING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId} AND lease_version = #{leaseVersion} AND published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL

UPDATE mk_event_outbox SET publish_state = 'DEAD', publish_attempts = #{publishAttempts}, dead_lettered_at = #{stateAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND outbox_id = #{outboxId} AND publish_state = 'SENDING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId} AND lease_version = #{leaseVersion} AND published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL

UPDATE mk_event_outbox SET publish_state = 'PENDING', publish_attempts = #{publishAttempts}, next_attempt_at = #{stateAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND outbox_id = #{outboxId} AND publish_state = 'SENDING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId} AND lease_version = #{leaseVersion} AND published_at IS NULL AND dead_lettered_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM mk_event_outbox WHERE publish_state IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING')
